tools.name: get_exchange_rates
tools.description: Get current ZEC exchange rates against fiat currencies (USD, EUR, BRL, GBP, etc). No authentication required.

tools.name: create_invoice
tools.description: Create a Zcash payment invoice. Returns a payment address, ZIP-321 URI (for wallet deep-linking), amount in ZEC, and expiry time. Requires CIPHERPAY_API_KEY.

currency.description: Fiat currency code: USD, EUR, BRL, GBP, CAD, JPY, MXN, ARS, NGN, CHF, INR

product_id.description: CipherPay product UUID (if selling a registered product)

price_id.description: CipherPay price UUID (if using a registered price)

tools.name: get_invoice_status
tools.description: Check a CipherPay invoice status, including pending, underpaid, detected, confirmed, expired, cancelled or refunded. Underpaid means a partial receipt, not a completed payment. No authentication required.

invoice_id.description: Invoice UUID or memo code (e.g. "CP-1234" or a UUID)

tools.name: verify_payment
tools.description: Verify a shielded Zcash payment by transaction ID, for x402 or MPP (agentic payment) resource servers. Checks a confirmed payment amount via trial decryption. A successful verification consumes that payment; it is not an invoice-status update. Requires CIPHERPAY_API_KEY. Requests time out after 30 seconds. A timeout is inconclusive; check the merchant payment history before retrying.

expected_amount_zec.description: Expected ZEC amount in whole zatoshis (at most 8 decimal places, e.g. 0.001)

protocol.description: Payment protocol used (x402 or mpp). Defaults to x402.

tools.name: prepare_session
tools.description: Prepare a prepaid session deposit before sending funds. Returns a unique deposit address and session_request_id. Requires CIPHERPAY_API_KEY for this merchant. This tool does not send funds.

merchant_id.description: Merchant UUID to prepare the session deposit for

tools.name: open_session
tools.description: Open a prepaid session after prepare_session and a confirmed deposit to its unique address. Returns a bearer token and balance for subsequent API calls without per-request payments. Requires session_request_id and CIPHERPAY_API_KEY. Legacy shared-memo deposits are unsupported.

txid.description: 64-character hex Zcash transaction ID of the deposit

session_request_id.description: Required request ID from prepare_session, obtained before sending the deposit

merchant_id.description: Deprecated legacy parameter; does not replace session_request_id

refund_address.description: Zcash address for refund of unused balance (recommended)

tools.name: get_session_status
tools.description: Check the status and remaining balance of an active session. Requires CIPHERPAY_API_KEY.

tools.name: close_session
tools.description: Close a session and get a final summary. If a refund address was provided, shows the refund details for the merchant. Requires CIPHERPAY_API_KEY.

tools.name: get_product_info
tools.description: Get details about a CipherPay product including its name, description, and available prices. No authentication required.

tools.name: get_merchant_info
tools.description: Get merchant account details on API-key-enabled backends. Requires CIPHERPAY_API_KEY. Backend versions that restrict this endpoint to dashboard sessions return an authorization error with guidance.

tools.name: list_invoices
tools.description: List invoices within the newest 50 records exposed by the API, with status, amount, and creation time. Pagination applies within this window, not the complete account history. Requires CIPHERPAY_API_KEY.

limit.description: Number of invoices within the newest-50 window to return

tools.name: cancel_invoice
tools.description: Cancel a pending invoice on API-key-enabled backends. Requires CIPHERPAY_API_KEY. Backend versions that restrict this endpoint to dashboard sessions return an authorization error with guidance.

tools.name: list_products
tools.description: List all your CipherPay products. Requires CIPHERPAY_API_KEY.

tools.name: create_product
tools.description: Create a product on API-key-enabled backends. Requires CIPHERPAY_API_KEY and a default_amount for the current API. Backend versions that restrict this endpoint to dashboard sessions return an authorization error with guidance.

tools.name: list_prices
tools.description: List product prices with CIPHERPAY_API_KEY on API-key-enabled backends. When management access is denied, returns an explicitly labeled active public subset if available. Private or inactive prices require management access.

tools.name: create_payment_link
tools.description: Create a payment link for a price or a product default price. Returns its ID and slug; use the /link/{slug} path on your CipherPay frontend. Custom slugs are unsupported by the current API. Requires CIPHERPAY_API_KEY.

product_id.description: Product UUID or slug with a default price

slug.description: Custom URL slug for the payment link

tools.name: list_webhooks
tools.description: List webhook delivery history on API-key-enabled backends. Requires CIPHERPAY_API_KEY. Backend versions that restrict this endpoint to dashboard sessions return an authorization error with guidance.
